title: Tooling, modules & packages
course_section: Programming fundamentals, dev environment, go mod, housekeeping

hints.TestIncrement: Declare `var count int` OUTSIDE the function (package scope) so it survives between calls, then `count++` and return it.
hints.TestIsExported: Decode the first rune with utf8.DecodeRuneInString(name) and check unicode.IsUpper(r). Watch out for the empty string.
hints.TestSHA256Hex: sum := sha256.Sum256(data); return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) (packages crypto/sha256 and encoding/hex), or fmt.Sprintf("%x", sum).
hints.TestBump: strings.TrimPrefix(v, "v"), strings.Split(..., "."), strconv.Atoi each part. Bumping minor resets patch; bumping major resets minor and patch.

quiz.q: In Go, what makes an identifier visible outside its package?
options: starting it with a capital letter
putting it in an exported block
quiz.why: Capitalized identifiers are exported. Lowercase ones are not.

options: adds missing and removes unused dependencies, updating go.sum
quiz.why: It makes go.mod and go.sum match what your code actually imports.

quiz.q: A release adds a new backwards-compatible feature to v1.4.2. The next version is:
quiz.why: MINOR is bumped for backwards-compatible features, and PATCH resets to 0.

quiz.q: How do you build a Linux binary from a Mac?
quiz.why: Set the GOOS (and optionally GOARCH) environment variables.

quiz.q: What is the difference between an expression and a statement?
options: an expression evaluates to a value; a statement performs an action
expressions only exist in if conditions
quiz.why: 2+7 is an expression. x := 2+7 is a statement.

quiz.q: chmod 754 gives the world (others) which permissions?
quiz.why: The digits are owner, group, world. 4 = read only.
